summary: Specifies how IPv6 packets are encapsulated for transmission over Fibre Channel, and how link-local and stateless autoconfigured addresses are formed on such networks. It was replaced by RFC 4338.

eli5.summary: This document says how to put IPv6 envelopes into the special boxes used by storage networks. It was replaced by RFC 4338.

questions: how are ipv6 addresses formed on fibre channel
